design_name: STILL INFEASIBLE AS STATED - alternative open-system substitute: Polar-bear-fur-inspired transparent-insulation solar absorber wall
inspiration_source: Polar bear pelt (hollow translucent guard hairs over dark skin) as a solar-thermal collector; the stated request itself has no valid biological or physical analog
physical_mechanism: FEASIBILITY NOTE (unchanged from the previous attempt, because the failure reason was the request, not the concept): a surface in a completely closed, adiabatic system without energy input cannot deliver sustained net heat to a house; this violates the first law of thermodynamics (perpetual motion of the first kind), and a 'Wirkungsgrad' > 300 % in the sense of heat out > total energy in is impossible for any concept. Changing the bionic inspiration cannot fix this, so a 'completely new concept' that fulfils the request does not exist. As a physically valid alternative that heats a house without fuel or electricity, this design uses an OPEN system with solar input: hollow, translucent fibre layer (polar bear guard hairs) transmits short-wave radiation to a dark absorber while suppressing convective and long-wave losses; the absorbed solar flux conducts through a massive wall into the house. Efficiency (heat to house / incident solar energy) is necessarily < 100 %. Modeled physics: steady 1D conduction through the wall with volumetric absorption, d2T/dx2 = -q_abs*L^2/k, with fixed absorber-side and room-side temperatures; energy is conserved exactly.

parameters.name: wall_thickness
parameters.justification: m, massive storage wall (Trombe wall) thickness.

parameters.name: absorbed_heat_source
parameters.justification: W/m^3 volumetric absorption equivalent in the absorber region, averaged; order of 30 W/m^2 winter solar gain over 0.3 m.

parameters.name: absorber_temperature
parameters.justification: K, absorber-side wall surface under the fibre layer on a sunny winter day.
